name: marble-theme
title: Marble theme
description: Tokens, materials, motion and base styles, plus the theme provider (d toggles dark mode).
docs: Add @import "./marble.css"; to app/globals.css after the Tailwind, tw-animate-css and shadcn/tailwind.css imports. Load Geist, Geist Mono and Bricolage Grotesque as --font-sans, --font-mono and --font-display, and wrap the app in <ThemeProvider>.
